title: QUEEN ON THE LINE
caption: Take the queen. Lose the king.
speak: Take the queen, lose the king!

title: THE BAIT
caption: The knight opens the diagonal.
speak: The knight opens the diagonal! The queen is exposed.

title: QUEEN CAPTURED
caption: Black takes the queen!
speak: Black takes the queen! But watch the bishop.

title: COUNTERATTACK
caption: Bishop takes F7. Check!
speak: Bishop takes F seven. Check! The knight has its back.

title: ONLY LEGAL REPLY
caption: The king has to step to E7.
speak: The king has to step to E seven.

title: CHECKMATE
caption: The second knight jumps to D5. Mate!
speak: The second knight jumps to D five. Checkmate!
